[Erowid Note: Unconfirmed Death Report. This report of a death was submitted with no verifiable details, no contact information, and no way to confirm any element of it. Erowid is choosing to publish this report to invite public comment and to allow anyone who knows about this event to submit details which we can verify.

Neither this report nor any report of a death should be considered reliable -- nor much weight given to it -- without details that can be verified through hospitals, police reports, family members, or news reports. If you have information about this or other deaths directly resulting from the use of any psychoactive substance we cover, please contact sage at erowid.org.]
[Erowid Note: From what we've surmised, this appears to be a fictionalized account based on an actual Oxycontin-related death, written by a friend of the deceased.]
I was just in the middle of unpacking boxes after I just moved into my new house. I finally got a home I could afford or in other words the state was helping me pay. My back was killing me and I knew I needed a dose of medicine.
So I melted down a 40 mg dose of oxycontin and drew it up in a syringe and injected it in my arm. I felt my body going down and started to call a friend for help. But they were not there and so I just slumped down on the floor. I felt my body drifting off into another world. All I could think of was what a good feeling this was. I did not care anymore about anything. Finally I had no pain.
The next day in the afternoon my family and friend found my body still laying on the floor slumped over. Not caring about anything at this point.
My body was taken away from my new house. 90 days later My family was told that I died of oxycontin. I left 2 young children to be raised by their now single father.
This was the ultimate oxy dream. I no longer hurt but the ones who are left behind does.
